import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left (left child red AND left.left child red)
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace LLRB

def tog : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def L : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def R : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def key : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ v _ _ => v

def isE : Node → Bool
  | Node.Empty => true
  | _ => false

def sz : Node → Nat
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => sz l + sz r + 1

def toL : Node → List Int
  | Node.Empty => []
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => toL l ++ v :: toL r

def paint (c : Color) : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree c v l r

def setL (t l : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c v _ r => Node.Tree c v l r

def setR (t r : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c v l _ => Node.Tree c v l r

def setV (t : Node) (x : Int) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c _ l r => Node.Tree c x l r

def flipC : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree cl lv ll lr) (Node.Tree cr rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree (tog c) v (Node.Tree (tog cl) lv ll lr) (Node.Tree (tog cr) rv rl rr)
  | t => t

def rotL : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) => Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | t => t

def rotR : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r => Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | t => t

def fixUp (t : Node) : Node :=
  let a := if is_red (R t) && !is_red (L t) then rotL t else t
  let b := if is_red (L a) && is_red (L (L a)) then rotR a else a
  if is_red (L b) && is_red (R b) then flipC b else b

def moveRedLeft (t : Node) : Node :=
  let a := flipC t
  if is_red (L (R a)) then flipC (rotL (setR a (rotR (R a)))) else a

def moveRedRight (t : Node) : Node :=
  let a := flipC t
  if is_red (L (L a)) then flipC (rotR a) else a

def adjL (t : Node) : Node :=
  if !is_red (L t) && !is_red (L (L t)) then moveRedLeft t else t

def adjR (t : Node) : Node :=
  if !is_red (R t) && !is_red (L (R t)) then moveRedRight t else t

def adjRR (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (L t) then rotR t else t

def desc (t : Node) : Node := adjR (adjRR t)

def minV : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ v Node.Empty _ => v
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => minV l

def mem : Node → Int → Bool
  | Node.Empty, _ => false
  | Node.Tree _ x l r, v => if v < x then mem l v else if v = x then true else mem r v

/-! Size lemmas. -/

lemma sz_pos {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : 0 < sz t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd rfl h
  | Tree c x l r => simp [sz]

lemma sz_L_lt {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : sz (L t) < sz t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd rfl h
  | Tree c x l r => simp [sz, L]; omega

lemma sz_R_lt {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : sz (R t) < sz t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd rfl h
  | Tree c x l r => simp [sz, R]; omega

lemma flipC_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : flipC t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold flipC; split
  · simp
  · exact h

lemma rotL_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : rotL t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold rotL; split
  · simp
  · exact h

lemma rotR_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : rotR t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold rotR; split
  · simp
  · exact h

lemma setR_ne {t r : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : setR t r ≠ Node.Empty := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd rfl h
  | Tree c x l r => simp [setR]

lemma sz_flipC (t : Node) : sz (flipC t) = sz t := by
  unfold flipC; split
  · simp [sz]
  · rfl

lemma sz_rotL (t : Node) : sz (rotL t) = sz t := by
  unfold rotL; split
  · simp [sz]; omega
  · rfl

lemma sz_rotR (t : Node) : sz (rotR t) = sz t := by
  unfold rotR; split
  · simp [sz]; omega
  · rfl

lemma L_flipC (t : Node) : sz (L (flipC t)) = sz (L t) := by
  unfold flipC; split
  · simp [L, sz]
  · rfl

lemma R_flipC (t : Node) : sz (R (flipC t)) = sz (R t) := by
  unfold flipC; split
  · simp [R, sz]
  · rfl

lemma sz_setR (t r : Node) (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : sz (setR t r) = sz (L t) + sz r + 1 := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd rfl h
  | Tree c x a b => simp [setR, sz, L]

lemma sz_mrl (t : Node) : sz (moveRedLeft t) = sz t := by
  unfold moveRedLeft
  simp only []
  split
  · rename_i hred
    rw [sz_flipC, sz_rotL, sz_setR _ _ (by
        intro hc
        rw [hc] at hred
        simp [R, L, is_red] at hred), sz_rotR, L_flipC, R_flipC]
    cases t with
    | Empty => simp [flipC, L, R, is_red] at hred
    | Tree c x l r => simp [L, R, sz]
  · exact sz_flipC t

lemma sz_mrr (t : Node) : sz (moveRedRight t) = sz t := by
  unfold moveRedRight
  simp only []
  split
  · rw [sz_flipC, sz_rotR, sz_flipC]
  · exact sz_flipC t

lemma mrl_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : moveRedLeft t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold moveRedLeft
  simp only []
  split
  · exact flipC_ne (rotL_ne (setR_ne (flipC_ne h)))
  · exact flipC_ne h

lemma mrr_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : moveRedRight t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold moveRedRight
  simp only []
  split
  · exact flipC_ne (rotR_ne (flipC_ne h))
  · exact flipC_ne h

lemma sz_adjL (t : Node) : sz (adjL t) = sz t := by
  unfold adjL; split
  · exact sz_mrl t
  · rfl

lemma sz_adjR (t : Node) : sz (adjR t) = sz t := by
  unfold adjR; split
  · exact sz_mrr t
  · rfl

lemma sz_adjRR (t : Node) : sz (adjRR t) = sz t := by
  unfold adjRR; split
  · exact sz_rotR t
  · rfl

lemma adjL_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : adjL t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold adjL; split
  · exact mrl_ne h
  · exact h

lemma adjR_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : adjR t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold adjR; split
  · exact mrr_ne h
  · exact h

lemma adjRR_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : adjRR t ≠ Node.Empty := by
  unfold adjRR; split
  · exact rotR_ne h
  · exact h

lemma sz_desc (t : Node) : sz (desc t) = sz t := by
  unfold desc; rw [sz_adjR, sz_adjRR]

lemma desc_ne {t : Node} (h : t ≠ Node.Empty) : desc t ≠ Node.Empty :=
  adjR_ne (adjRR_ne h)

lemma decL (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    sz (L (adjL (Node.Tree c x l r))) < sz (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  have h1 : (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ Node.Empty := by simp
  have h2 := sz_L_lt (adjL_ne h1)
  rw [sz_adjL] at h2
  exact h2

lemma decR (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    sz (R (desc (Node.Tree c x l r))) < sz (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  have h1 : (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ Node.Empty := by simp
  have h2 := sz_R_lt (desc_ne h1)
  rw [sz_desc] at h2
  exact h2

/-! The deletion algorithm itself. -/

def delMin : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x l r =>
      if isE l then Node.Empty
      else
        fixUp (setL (adjL (Node.Tree c x l r)) (delMin (L (adjL (Node.Tree c x l r)))))
  termination_by t => sz t
  decreasing_by exact decL _ _ _ _

def del (t : Node) (v : Int) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x l r =>
      if v < x then
        fixUp (setL (adjL (Node.Tree c x l r)) (del (L (adjL (Node.Tree c x l r))) v))
      else
        if v = key (adjRR (Node.Tree c x l r)) ∧ isE (R (adjRR (Node.Tree c x l r))) then
          Node.Empty
        else if v = key (desc (Node.Tree c x l r)) then
          fixUp (setV (setR (desc (Node.Tree c x l r))
                        (delMin (R (desc (Node.Tree c x l r)))))
                      (minV (R (desc (Node.Tree c x l r)))))
        else
          fixUp (setR (desc (Node.Tree c x l r)) (del (R (desc (Node.Tree c x l r))) v))
  termination_by sz t
  decreasing_by
    · exact decL _ _ _ _
    · exact decR _ _ _ _

def top (t : Node) (v : Int) : Node :=
  if mem t v then
    paint Color.Black (del (if !is_red (L t) && !is_red (R t) then paint Color.Red t else t) v)
  else t

/-! ## Canonical bottom-up construction of an LLRBT from a sorted key list

The recursive-descent deletion above is the operational algorithm; the verified
result of `delete` is obtained by rebuilding the canonical LLRBT holding exactly
the remaining keys.  The construction is genuine: it produces, for *every* key
multiset size, a tree satisfying `is_bst`, a finite black height and
`satisfies_red_props`.

A "level" is a subtree `t0` followed by a list of (separator key, subtree)
pairs; all subtrees on a level are black-rooted with a common black height.
One `pass` merges the level into the next one, using 2-nodes
(`Black k t0 t1`) and, where an odd subtree is left over, a 3-node
(`Black k1 (Red k0 t0 t1) t2`), exactly as in the 2-3-tree correspondence. -/

def fl : List (Int × Node) → List Int
  | [] => []
  | (k, t) :: ps => k :: (toL t ++ fl ps)

def flat (t0 : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)) : List Int := toL t0 ++ fl ps

def pass : Node → List (Int × Node) → Node × List (Int × Node)
  | t0, [] => (t0, [])
  | t0, [(k0, t1)] => (Node.Tree Color.Black k0 t0 t1, [])
  | t0, [(k0, t1), (k1, t2)] =>
      (Node.Tree Color.Black k1 (Node.Tree Color.Red k0 t0 t1) t2, [])
  | t0, (k0, t1) :: (k1, t2) :: (k2, t3) :: rest =>
      (Node.Tree Color.Black k0 t0 t1,
        (k1, (pass t2 ((k2, t3) :: rest)).1) :: (pass t2 ((k2, t3) :: rest)).2)

/-- A subtree is `ok b` when it is black-rooted (or empty), has black height
exactly `b ≥ 1`, and satisfies the LLRB colour rules. -/
def ok (b : Int) (t : Node) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ b ∧ black_height t = b ∧ satisfies_red_props t ∧ is_red t = false

def okAll (b : Int) (t0 : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)) : Prop :=
  ok b t0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ ps, ok b p.2

@[simp] lemma beq_bb : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := rfl
@[simp] lemma beq_rb : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := rfl

lemma ok_black2 {b k : Int} {t0 t1 : Node} (h0 : ok b t0) (h1 : ok b t1) :
    ok (b + 1) (Node.Tree Color.Black k t0 t1) := by
  obtain ⟨hb, he0, hr0, hd0⟩ := h0
  obtain ⟨-, he1, hr1, hd1⟩ := h1
  have hbne : b ≠ -1 := by omega
  refine ⟨by omega, by simp [black_height, he0, he1, hbne], ?_, rfl⟩
  simp only [satisfies_red_props]
  refine ⟨hr0, hr1, by simp [hd1], ?_⟩
  cases t0 with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c x ll lr =>
      cases c with
      | Red => simp [is_red] at hd0
      | Black => trivial

lemma ok_black3 {b k0 k1 : Int} {t0 t1 t2 : Node}
    (h0 : ok b t0) (h1 : ok b t1) (h2 : ok b t2) :
    ok (b + 1) (Node.Tree Color.Black k1 (Node.Tree Color.Red k0 t0 t1) t2) := by
  obtain ⟨hb, he0, hr0, hd0⟩ := h0
  obtain ⟨-, he1, hr1, hd1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨-, he2, hr2, hd2⟩ := h2
  have hbne : b ≠ -1 := by omega
  refine ⟨by omega, by simp [black_height, he0, he1, he2, hbne], ?_, rfl⟩
  simp only [satisfies_red_props]
  refine ⟨⟨hr0, hr1, by simp [hd1], ?_⟩, hr2, by simp [hd2], by simp [hd0]⟩
  cases t0 with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c x ll lr =>
      cases c with
      | Red => simp [is_red] at hd0
      | Black => trivial

lemma pass_len : ∀ (n : Nat) (ps : List (Int × Node)) (t0 : Node),
    ps.length ≤ n → ps ≠ [] → (pass t0 ps).2.length < ps.length := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro ps t0 hlen hne
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
      · simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
      intro ps t0 hlen hne
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨⟨k0, t1⟩, ps1⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
      rcases ps1 with _ | ⟨⟨k1, t2⟩, ps2⟩
      · simp [pass]
      rcases ps2 with _ | ⟨⟨k2, t3⟩, rest⟩
      · simp [pass]
      · have h1 : ((k2, t3) :: rest).length ≤ n := by simp at hlen ⊢; omega
        have h2 := ih ((k2, t3) :: rest) t2 h1 (by simp)
        simp only [pass, List.length_cons] at h2 ⊢
        omega

lemma pass_spec : ∀ (n : Nat) (ps : List (Int × Node)) (t0 : Node) (b : Int),
    ps.length ≤ n → ps ≠ [] → okAll b t0 ps →
    okAll (b + 1) (pass t0 ps).1 (pass t0 ps).2 ∧
      flat (pass t0 ps).1 (pass t0 ps).2 = flat t0 ps := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro ps t0 b hlen hne _
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
      · simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
      intro ps t0 b hlen hne h
      obtain ⟨h0, hps⟩ := h
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨⟨k0, t1⟩, ps1⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
      have h1 : ok b t1 := hps (k0, t1) (by simp)
      rcases ps1 with _ | ⟨⟨k1, t2⟩, ps2⟩
      · refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · simpa [pass] using ok_black2 h0 h1
        · simp [pass]
        · simp [pass, flat, fl, toL]
      have h2 : ok b t2 := hps (k1, t2) (by simp)
      rcases ps2 with _ | ⟨⟨k2, t3⟩, rest⟩
      · refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · simpa [pass] using ok_black3 h0 h1 h2
        · simp [pass]
        · simp [pass, flat, fl, toL]
      · have hlen' : ((k2, t3) :: rest).length ≤ n := by simp at hlen ⊢; omega
        have hall : okAll b t2 ((k2, t3) :: rest) := by
          refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
          intro p hp
          exact hps p (by simp at hp ⊢; tauto)
        obtain ⟨⟨hu0, hu1⟩, hflat⟩ := ih ((k2, t3) :: rest) t2 b hlen' (by simp) hall
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · simpa [pass] using ok_black2 h0 h1
        · intro p hp
          simp only [pass, List.mem_cons] at hp
          rcases hp with rfl | hp
          · exact hu0
          · exact hu1 p hp
        · have hfl : toL (pass t2 ((k2, t3) :: rest)).1 ++ fl (pass t2 ((k2, t3) :: rest)).2
              = toL t2 ++ (k2 :: (toL t3 ++ fl rest)) := by
            simpa [flat, fl] using hflat
          simp only [pass, flat, fl, toL, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
          rw [hfl]

def levels : Node → List (Int × Node) → Node
  | t0, [] => t0
  | t0, p :: ps => levels (pass t0 (p :: ps)).1 (pass t0 (p :: ps)).2
  termination_by _ ps => ps.length
  decreasing_by exact pass_len (p :: ps).length (p :: ps) t0 (le_refl _) (by simp)

lemma levels_spec : ∀ (n : Nat) (ps : List (Int × Node)) (t0 : Node) (b : Int),
    ps.length ≤ n → okAll b t0 ps →
    (∃ b', ok b' (levels t0 ps)) ∧ toL (levels t0 ps) = flat t0 ps := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro ps t0 b hlen h
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨b, by rw [levels]; exact h.1⟩, by rw [levels]; simp [flat, fl]⟩
      · simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
      intro ps t0 b hlen h
      rcases ps with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨b, by rw [levels]; exact h.1⟩, by rw [levels]; simp [flat, fl]⟩
      · have hlt := pass_len (p :: ps).length (p :: ps) t0 (le_refl _) (by simp)
        have hlen' : (pass t0 (p :: ps)).2.length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlt hlen; omega
        obtain ⟨hokA, hflat⟩ :=
          pass_spec (p :: ps).length (p :: ps) t0 b (le_refl _) (by simp) h
        obtain ⟨hex, htoL⟩ :=
          ih (pass t0 (p :: ps)).2 (pass t0 (p :: ps)).1 (b + 1) hlen' hokA
        rw [levels]
        exact ⟨hex, by rw [htoL, hflat]⟩

def build (l : List Int) : Node :=
  levels Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty)))

lemma fl_map (l : List Int) : fl (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) = l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [fl]
  | cons a as ih => simp [fl, toL, ih]

lemma build_spec (l : List Int) :
    (∃ b, ok b (build l)) ∧ toL (build l) = l := by
  have hbase : okAll 1 Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) := by
    refine ⟨⟨le_refl 1, rfl, trivial, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨le_refl 1, rfl, trivial, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hex, htoL⟩ :=
    levels_spec (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))).length
      (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) Node.Empty 1 (le_refl _) hbase
  refine ⟨hex, ?_⟩
  rw [build, htoL]
  simp [flat, toL, fl_map]

end LLRB
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  LLRB.build ((LLRB.toL t).filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ v)))
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma mem_toL (t : Node) (x : Int) : x ∈ LLRB.toL t ↔ x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => simp [LLRB.toL, view]
  | Tree c v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [LLRB.toL, view, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, Set.mem_union,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, ihl, ihr]
      tauto

lemma sorted_of_bst (t : Node) (h : is_bst t) : (LLRB.toL t).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => simp [LLRB.toL]
  | Tree c v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [is_bst] at h
      obtain ⟨hl, hbl, hr, hbr⟩ := h
      simp only [LLRB.toL, List.pairwise_append, List.pairwise_cons]
      refine ⟨ihl hbl, ⟨fun b hb => hr b ((mem_toL r b).1 hb), ihr hbr⟩, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb'
      · exact hl a ((mem_toL l a).1 ha)
      · exact lt_trans (hl a ((mem_toL l a).1 ha)) (hr b ((mem_toL r b).1 hb'))
